featured_reviews.review_text: I got my bridal makeup done by Nikittaa Arora, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience! Highly recommend her to every bride-to-be — she’s an absolute gem to have on your big day!

featured_reviews.name: Jinal Botadra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience with Nikita Arora and her team for my 2-day event makeup, and I truly couldn’t have asked for better.

From the very first interaction, Nikita was extremely professional, warm and patient. She took the time to understand my preferences and created looks that were perfectly suited to my face, outfit and the occasion.

The team was right on time on both days, which made everything completely stress-free. Their hygiene standards were top-notch — all brushes, products and tools were properly cleaned and sanitized, which really matters to me.

The quality of the makeup was outstanding. My makeup looked fresh, elegant and flawless for many hours without any touch-ups, even after long functions and lots of movement. I received so many compliments from family and friends on both days — everyone kept asking who did my makeup!

What I appreciated most was the team’s calm behaviour, positive energy and attention to detail. They made me feel relaxed, confident and truly special on such important days.

I highly recommend Nikita Arora Bridal Makeup Studio & Academy to every bride and anyone looking for professional, high-quality makeup with a wonderful experience overall. Thank you Nikita for making my days even more memorable! 💕✨
